description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductViewed report model for the Opencart admin extension. It includes methods for installing/uninstalling the database table, adding report data, and retrieving view statistics.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Model class for managing the product viewed report, including database table creation, data insertion, and aggregation functions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_viewed' table in the database to store product IDs and their view counts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_viewed' table from the database.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts or updates the view count for a specific product.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products ordered by number of views, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of views across all products.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of view counts for all products.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the 'product_viewed' table, resetting all view counts.
